written.headline: Caleb Williams' 37.26 Powers madmaxwellog49 to Week 1's Top Score
written.subhead: Despite leaving a 33.80-point wideout on the bench, madmaxwellog49 posted 163.96 and opened the season as the league's lone 13-0 all-play team.
lead: Welcome to the 2026 season, Helmet Brigade, and what an opening statement from madmaxwellog49. Their 163.96 was the week's high score and a 38.20-point demolition of They Laported the Nabers. Quarterback Caleb Williams was the week's best player at 37.26, and Kenneth Walker (34.10) and Justin Jefferson (31.20) gave him plenty of help.

Here is the part that should frighten the other 13 managers. Jalen Coker sat on madmaxwellog49's bench and scored 33.80, while starter Chris Godwin managed 8.30. That is 25.50 points left on the pine, and the team still won by 38. The Gazette's all-play math has madmaxwellog49 beating all 13 other teams this week, and the playoff odds give them 97.4 percent to make the playoffs and 44.3 percent to take the top seed.

Chasing them are two teams that scored identical 138.36s. THE crab warriors, led by Ashton Jeanty's 32.70 and a 19.00 from kicker Evan McPherson, beat Jared's Big Papa by 11.24. GopherDeeznuts, with Josh Allen's 35.66 and Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 26.20, beat Bower Rangers by 11.26. Two points of margin separated by two hundredths, which is about as spooky as a season opener gets. GopherDeeznuts also posted a perfect 100.0 percent lineup efficiency, the only team to do so.

The Gazette also logged a week of benching crimes. Bower Rangers left Bryce Young's 32.44 on the bench for Matthew Stafford's 5.10 and lost by 11.26. Love is War lost by 2.32 with Caleb Douglas (14.40) sitting while Davante Adams scored 5.60. Both are our first lineup flips of the year, and it's only Week 1.

1.headline: Crab Warriors Edge Big Papa Despite Deebo Benching
1.body: THE crab warriors beat Jared's Big Papa 138.36 to 127.12, with Ashton Jeanty's 32.70 leading the way and Lamar Jackson adding 24.96. Zay Flowers scored 26.00 for Big Papa, but Jaylen Waddle's 1.20 in a starting slot hurt, with Michael Wilson's 10.60 on the bench. Manager crabwarrior also left Deebo Samuel's 18.00 on the bench and still won, so enjoy it. Big Papa's 127.12 would have beaten 9 of the other 13 teams.

2.headline: RomoCop Rolls Let Him Cook by 36.44
2.body: RomoCop beat Let Him Cook 128.10 to 91.66, with Jaxson Dart (26.60), Trey McBride (24.50) and Javonte Williams (24.20) all coming up big. Let Him Cook's top scorer was the Pittsburgh Steelers defense at 20.00, and Kyle Monangai's 20.40 sat on the bench while Quinshon Judkins scored 7.00. JerryMick will want that lineup back.

3.headline: Olichode Survives Week 1 With 95.24 and a Lot of Luck
3.body: Olichode beat Boomer Sooner 95.24 to 86.84, with Isaiah Likely's 27.80 doing the heavy lifting. That total would have beaten only 3 of 13 teams, making it the week's luckiest win. Chuba Hubbard scored 23.70 on Olichode's bench while Kenny Gainwell managed 2.80 in the lineup. Boomer Sooner got a goose egg from Colston Loveland and the Gazette's worst-starter award.

4.headline: madmaxwellog49 Flattens Nabers With Week's High Score
4.body: madmaxwellog49 posted 163.96 to beat They Laported the Nabers' 125.76, with Caleb Williams scoring 37.26. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 33.60 and Chris Olave 28.20 for lakesleeper, but Joe Burrow gave only 15.16. Stefon Diggs scored 15.50 on the bench while Terry McLaurin put up 3.40 in the lineup.

5.headline: jjssrrgg Escapes Love is War by 2.32
5.body: The week's nailbiter went to jjssrrgg, 117.00 to 114.68, as Derrick Henry's 35.30 outdueled Bijan Robinson's 31.30. Love is War is left to stew over Caleb Douglas sitting with 14.40 while Davante Adams scored 5.60, an 8.80-point swing that cost the game. jjssrrgg also left Jordan Love's 20.48 on the bench for Dak Prescott's 15.40, but it didn't matter.

6.headline: Bryce Young's Bench Seat Costs Bower Rangers the Game
6.body: GopherDeeznuts beat Bower Rangers 138.36 to 127.10, with Josh Allen (35.66) and D'Andre Swift (32.40) leading the charge. Bower Rangers had Christian Watson at 32.70 and David Montgomery at 28.90, but benched Bryce Young's 32.44 for Matthew Stafford's 5.10. That 27.34-point gap is the biggest in the league and was far more than the 11.26 margin.

7.headline: AMBULANCE! Leaves mikhawk in the Ruins, 124.06 to 62.12
7.body: AMBULANCE! won the week's biggest blowout by 61.94 behind Patrick Mahomes (22.66), Nico Collins (21.20) and Bucky Irving (20.30). mikhawk's 62.12 was the week's low, and Trevor Lawrence's 26.10 sat on the bench while Drake Maye scored 12.82. In all, 33.48 points went unused, a lineup efficiency of just 65.0 percent.

column.title: The Bench Is Not a Witness Protection Program
body: Fourteen teams played Week 1 and an alarming number of them seem to have set lineups by closing their eyes. Bower Rangers left 32.44 points from Bryce Young on the bench and lost by 11.26. Love is War lost by 2.32 with Caleb Douglas sitting on 14.40. Even the winner of the week, madmaxwellog49, left 33.80 from Jalen Coker unused. Good teams survive that, but good habits don't start that way.

Special mention goes to the league's moves. Love is War and Boomer Sooner swapped every one of their 2026 picks, 1st through 14th round, for each other. The tracker has it at 0.00 points apiece, so the Gazette can only say: bold, confusing and totally worth watching. Elsewhere, They Laported the Nabers bid 105 for Devaughn Vele, which is a lot of faith in one wideout. Meanwhile THE crab warriors picked up the Kansas City Chiefs defense for free and got 13.00 out of it, and madmaxwellog49 got 13.00 out of Tyler Bass the same way. Cheap beats expensive, at least for now.
